shellCommands.command:
node server.js &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 100
echo "---STATUS---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3000/
echo ""

curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "title=The+Hobbit&author=J.R.R.+Tolkien&notes=Loved+the+adventure" -i | head -n 20
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -A2 -i "Currently Reading"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'href="/books/[^"]*"'
cat books.json

BOOK_ID=$(cat books.json | grep -o '"id": "[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo $BOOK_ID
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID | head -n 80
echo "---FINISH---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID/finish -i | head -n 20
sleep 1
cat books.json
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -A5 "Finished"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$BOOK_ID | grep -i "Finished"

pkill -f "node server.js" || kill %1 || true
sleep 1
# verify persistence after restart: books.json still has finished book
cat books.json
# reset to empty for evaluator clean state
echo '[]' > books.json
cat books.json

# restart server in background for evaluator (they will run npm start themselves, but leave a process or not?)
# We'll start and then kill so they can start fresh
PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q "Currently Reading" && echo "homepage OK"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q "Add a book" && echo "form OK"
# kill again to leave clean (evaluator might start own)
pkill -f "node server.js" || true
sleep 1
echo "clean exit"
ps aux | grep server || true
cat package.json
ls -lh
cat books.json; echo "---"; cat package.json; ls -lh /workspace
kill -9 $(lsof -t -i:3000) 2>/dev/null || pkill -f "node server.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo '[]' > /workspace/books.json; cat /workspace/books.json; ps aux | grep node || true; ls -la
jobs -l; bash -c 'echo [] > books.json && cat books.json'; ls -la

PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 2
echo "=== GET / ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Currently Reading|Finished|Add a book" 
echo "=== POST add JSON ==="
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert","notes":"Great sci-fi"}' -H "Accept: application/json"
echo ""
cat books.json
echo "=== GET /books/:id ==="
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
echo "ID=$ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E "Dune|Frank Herbert|Great sci-fi"
echo "=== MARK FINISHED ==="
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish -H "Accept: application/json" | cat
cat books.json
echo "=== RESTART TEST ==="
kill %1
sleep 1
PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 1
cat books.json
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Dune|Finished"
kill %1
sleep 1
echo "done"
cat books.json
# reset to empty for final state
echo '[]' > books.json
cat books.json

ps aux | grep -E "node|server" || true
sleep 1
# ensure we leave no running server so evaluator can start own
jobs
echo "--- checking listening port ---"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ && echo "still running" || echo "not running (expected if killed)"
cat books.json

nohup node server.js > server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 20
cat server.log
cat books.json

pkill -f "node server.js" 2>/dev/null || kill $(ps aux | grep "[n]ode server.js" | awk '{print $2}') 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
nohup node server.js > server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 5
cat server.log
ps aux | grep server

curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 5
cat server.log 2>&1
ps aux | head -n 20
cat server.log 2>&1 || echo no log; ls -la; curl -v http://localhost:3000/ 2>&1 | head -n 20

setsid node server.js > server.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 10
ps aux | grep node
cat server.log

ps aux | grep node
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -q "Currently Reading" && echo ok
cat books.json
